insights.insight: Static source can expose a plausible state path without establishing that the integrated product actually exhibits the defect; route to the cheapest integrated discriminator before granting build permission.
insights.promotion_reason: Already encoded by discrimination-before-redesign and reality-floor rules. OSS-0007 is a useful neighbor: a directly visible guard-contract asymmetry can justify a narrow reversible build at R1 without waiting for field evidence.

insights.insight: Independent evidence about a neighboring bug or the same component can support a failure family without confirming the exact mechanism under adjudication.
insights.promotion_reason: Recurring adjudication hazard, but still lacks an executable positive-control gate and closed holdout wave. HOLDOUT observations remain score-only.

insights.insight: A suspicious timing workaround is not itself permission to refactor; first reproduce the event mechanism with and without the workaround.
insights.promotion_reason: Single case, no neighbor control, no positive control and no HOLDOUT evidence.

insights.insight: A repository can establish exactly what the product does while remaining unable to establish that the behavior is a defect; when the unresolved question is intended interaction/configuration policy, route to OWNER instead of converting implementation certainty into build permission.
insights.promotion_reason: Already encoded by Neta's evidence/authority/permission separation. OSS-0008 independently supports the same boundary in HOLDOUT and is not used to modify the rule until the holdout wave closes. OSS-0007 is a neighbor where the local product contract is explicit enough to allow a narrow build.

insights.insight: When a product contract is explicit and equivalent controls already enforce it, one unguarded sibling path can justify a narrow reversible consistency fix without asserting any field outcome.
insights.promotion_reason: One case only. Needs repetition, a neighboring case where asymmetry is intentional, a failing guard test/positive control, and unseen HOLDOUT success before promotion.

decision_modes.note: BUILD_READY appeared for the first time in OSS-0007. FIELD_STOP remains absent.

failure_families.note: A local contract-asymmetry family appeared, while neighboring-ground-truth laundering replicated again. No promotion candidate yet.

authority_boundaries.note: OSS-0008 HOLDOUT directly confirmed OWNER routing. No FIELD_STOP case yet.

baseline_decision_deltas.note: OSS-0008 adds a fully surviving restraint delta; OSS-0009 adds a partially supported cheaper-discriminator delta.

protocol_warning: During candidate selection, a commit endpoint returned ChangeLog/commit-history content before the blind pass for Kanboard, and branch metadata exposed a bug-fix commit message for Vikunja. Both candidates were discarded before case assignment. Subsequent pinning used git/ref endpoints, which return only the ref and SHA. No contaminated repository entered the benchmark cases.
